fusions.name: Overrun
fusions.desc: Charges you up to 7 tiles to the target and slams it for 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Turned at Bay
fusions.desc: Swipes every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Guard the Carcass
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
